response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_status_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT status, average_hgb, average_ratio, average_ratio / mean_status_ratio AS ratio_relative_to_mean FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_status_ratio IS NOT NULL
